about.title: Morgan Hill Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Morgan Hill's mix of longtime residential neighborhoods, agricultural operations, and light industry near US-101 means defective products show up in all kinds of everyday settings — a malfunctioning power tool in a garage off Monterey Road, a faulty appliance in a home near downtown, or unsafe farm equipment used on outlying properties. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a strict liability claim, meaning you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. That's a meaningful advantage for families in a city like Morgan Hill, where a single injury can affect work, school pickups, and daily routines built around a smaller community. If a product hurt you or someone in your household, holding onto the item, packaging, and receipts can matter a great deal later. Our team handles product liability cases in Morgan Hill and can evaluate what happened and explain your options.

whyChoose.title: Why Morgan Hill Families Choose Us

items.title: Strict Liability Can Ease Your Burden
items.desc: California often allows product claims to proceed under strict liability, meaning you generally don't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that a defect existed and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which matters when a defective product passed through several hands before reaching a Morgan Hill home or worksite.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Because these cases often hinge on examining the item itself, we can advise you early on how to properly store and protect the product as evidence.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often rely on strict liability, which generally focuses on whether the product was defective and caused your injury rather than on the manufacturer's conduct. We can explain how this applies to your specific situation.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep the item, its packaging, and any related receipts or manuals in the same condition as when the injury happened. This physical evidence is often central to product cases, and we can advise on safe storage.

items.question: I live near Monterey Road in Morgan Hill — does that affect my claim?
items.answer: Your location itself doesn't determine the outcome, but where you bought or used the product, and any local records like store receipts or repair visits, can help establish the timeline. Our team can walk through those details with you.

items.question: Is there a cost to contact us?
items.answer: No. Our initial consultation is free, and we generally work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
